description: JD-driven tutorial suggestion, front of the funnel (74-band). Add the ingest step of a net-new growth surface that does NOT exist in the code today: import a job description and normalize it to one canonical plain-text JD document that the later extraction/gap/suggestion bands read. Import is by copy-paste OR file upload, parsing .txt/.md/.pdf/.docx down to plain text; the read path is BYO-key-OPTIONAL because plain text needs no model. This band adds only ingest — no extraction, no suggestion — and lands a new Python module in the construction core (praxis/) plus an in-app entry point, following the storage discipline that all user data (the imported JD) lives under the active backend root via praxis/storage.py, never in the repo. Depends on the shipped Define (20) + Construct (30) spine, whose scaffolder/subjects flow the accepted suggestions eventually feed. Anti-fabrication: a JD is 'ingested' only when a real uploaded/pasted document lands as normalized plain text on the active storage backend and round-trips back out — never a stubbed string.
warmup: echo '--- storage is the only path resolver ---'; grep -n 'def subjects_dir\|def progress_dir\|def app_dir\|_RESOLVERS' praxis/storage.py curriculum.py progress.py 2>/dev/null | head
echo '--- how the app already accepts free text -> a persisted artifact ---'; sed -n '425,477p' launcher/app.py

userStories.title: Parse and normalize a JD to one canonical plain-text document
acceptanceCriteria: A new module in the Python construction core (e.g. praxis/jd.py) ingests a job description from raw pasted text OR an uploaded file, parsing .txt / .md / .pdf / .docx down to plain text and normalizing whitespace/encoding into one canonical JD document with a stable shape (source, mime/kind, normalized text, timestamp).

The plain-text and .md paths need NO API key (BYO-key-optional read path); only formats that require a parser pull in that parser, and an unsupported/undecodable upload fails with a clear actionable error rather than persisting garbage.

The canonical JD is written under the active storage backend root via praxis/storage.py delegates (never a hand-computed path, never inside the repo), so it follows app / drive / cloud exactly as subjects and progress do.

Gate green: python3 -m pytest -q tests/ passes, including a test that ingests each supported format (with a fixture file per type) and asserts the normalized text round-trips back off the storage backend in a second read.

userStories.title: In-app JD import by paste or upload
acceptanceCriteria: The launcher exposes an ingest endpoint (e.g. POST /api/jd taking pasted text or an uploaded file) that calls the US-1 core and returns the persisted canonical JD's id/handle; it honors the writable() 503 middleware exactly like every other non-GET write, so an unplugged drive refuses cleanly.

A UI surface lets the user paste JD text or pick a file to upload and shows the ingested JD back for confirmation; it reuses the shell's existing cross-origin fetch path (SHELL_ORIGIN_RE) with no widening to '*'.

Gate green: npm run build in ui/ and cargo build in src-tauri/ both pass, and python3 -m pytest -q tests/ covers the endpoint (paste + upload) with the launch extra; document the end-to-end paste->persisted->reloaded round trip in the progress log.
